articleTitle: Why Your Estradiol Gel Sits on Your Skin for Hours
imageHeadline: Your estradiol gel isn't broken—your skin is
imageSubtext: Why absorption varies and what to adjust before you worry
pinTitle: Why Estradiol Gel Takes Hours to Absorb (And What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: If your estradiol gel sits on your skin for over an hour or leaves residue the next day, absorption may vary by application site, skin hydration, and timing. Learn what affects transdermal hormone absorption and what to try before assuming it's not working.
